summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its total voting rights and capital as of 31 July 2026, as required by UK Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. The filing details issued ordinary shares (7,959,762,256), treasury shares, and preference shares, with total voting rights of 31,840,981,584. This is a routine regulatory notification with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic actions. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is informational only, providing shareholders a figure to determine notification thresholds. There is no transaction to monitor or risk-arbitrage angle, as it reflects standard ongoing disclosure obligations.
